description: Median of three signed integers with nested comparisons (median-of-three pivot)
notes: Real-world idiom (quicksort pivot selection) written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps three branches and two smin: 12 IR instructions. A shorter IR form is known and proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 (%4 = call i32 @llvm.smin.i32(i32 %0, i32 %1) %5 = call i32 @llvm.smax.i32(i32 %0, i32 %1) %6 = call i32 @llvm.smin.i32(i32 %5, i32 %2) %7 = call i32 @llvm.smax.i32(i32 %4, i32 %6)), but it is SLOWER than clang -O3 in llvm-mca on Skylake: 4.88 -> 5.04 cycles (Benoit, reference toolchain, 2026-10-28). No faster version is known, so the entry is C (moved B -> C on 2026-10-28, expected.ll removed).
